title: TaskMaster v3 — Canonical Schema
description: Complete API, data model, WebSocket event, and filesystem schema for TaskMaster v3. Source of truth for agents, clients, and tooling.

taskStatus.description: pending=awaiting execution, in_progress=locked and running, done=successfully completed, blocked=dependency or gate failure, failed=execution failed

projectStatus.description: active=in progress, completed=all tiers done, archived=moved to archive/, awaiting_approval=waiting for tier gate, paused=workflow paused by user

tierNames.note: Tiers 6+ are valid — rendered as 'Tier N'

Task.description: A single unit of work within a project tier

id.description: Unique task identifier. Auto-generated format: task-001, task-002, … Padded to 3 digits.

description.description: Full task description. May include markdown.

tier.description: Workflow tier number (0-5+). Defaults to 0 if omitted.

agent.description: Name of the assigned agent (e.g. AGENT_ARTIST, AGENT_SPEC)

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created

started.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task moved to in_progress

completed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task reached done status

locked_by.description: Agent name holding the current lock. Null when not locked.

locked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the lock was acquired. Null when not locked.

reclaim_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the lock may be reclaimed. Extended by heartbeat. Null when not locked.

heartbeat_interval.description: Seconds between expected heartbeat signals for this task. Default: 30.

gate.description: Gate name for tier approval (e.g. 'qa', 'security', 'review'). Null means no gate.

depends_on.description: Array of task IDs that must have status 'done' before this task can be locked or assigned

requires_human.description: If true, blocks lock and assign endpoints until manually cleared to false. Use for tasks needing human review before execution.

last_updated_by.description: Name of the agent or 'system' that last modified this task

last_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification to this task

Project.description: A project loaded from the projects/ directory

id.description: Project directory name, used as slug in all API paths

name.description: Human-readable project name, parsed from project.md frontmatter

currentTier.description: Calculated: highest tier where tasks are still pending or in_progress

lastAccessed.description: Filesystem mtime of the project directory

created.description: Project creation date parsed from project.md frontmatter (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601)

completedTiers.description: Tier numbers where every task has status 'done'

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the project directory

isArchived.description: True if the project lives in archive/ rather than projects/

ProjectMetadata.description: Computed task counts for a project

TasksJson.description: Schema for the tasks.json file on disk inside each project directory

approvedTier.description: The tier number that has been explicitly approved via manual approval workflow

paused.description: Whether the workflow is currently paused

TasksJsonMetadata.description: Metadata block written inside tasks.json. Updated on every write.

created.description: ISO timestamp when the tasks.json was first created

updated.description: ISO timestamp of last write to tasks.json

LockFile.description: Schema for lock files written to projects/{id}/locks/{taskId}.lock

agent.description: Name of the agent holding this lock

pid.description: OS process ID of the agent process

LLMProviderConfig.description: Configuration for an external LLM provider, stored in user-settings.json and returned by GET /api/settings

id.description: Provider identifier used in call_llm and modelDefaults (e.g. 'gemini-flash', 'deepseek')

model.description: Model identifier sent in the request body

UserSettings.description: Full user settings object returned by GET /api/settings and written by POST /api/settings

customLinks.description: User-defined shortcut links shown in the UI

thresholds.description: Task age thresholds in minutes for colour coding in the UI

green.description: Minutes before a task turns orange

orange.description: Minutes before a task turns red

providers.description: Configured LLM providers. Used by call_llm MCP tool and POST /api/settings/test-model.

modelDefaults.description: Maps task categories to provider IDs. Agents should resolve provider from here rather than hardcoding.

research.description: Provider ID to use for research tasks

coding.description: Provider ID to use for code generation tasks

ingestion.description: Provider ID to use for ingestion/summarisation tasks

LogEntry.description: A parsed log entry emitted via WebSocket or stored in agent_logs.md

tag.description: Semantic log tag used by AGENT TASKMASTER

context.description: Task ID, tier number, or other context identifier

projectDirectory.description: One directory per project, auto-discovered by server on startup

emoji.description: Optional emoji icon for the project UI

project.md.example:
---
name: TM Notes
emoji: 📝
status: active
created: 2026-02-24
type: client-mini-app
---

# TM Notes

Project description here...

tasks.json.description: Task list for this project. See models.TasksJson for schema.
tasks.json.note: Do not edit directly while the server is running. Use the REST API.

agentlogs.md.description: Append-only agent execution log. Written by AGENT TASKMASTER using the [AGENT ROLE: TAG] format.

locks/{taskId}.lock.description: Lock file created when a task is claimed. See models.LockFile for schema. Deleted on unlock or task completion.

archiveDirectory.description: Projects moved here via POST /api/projects/:id/archive. Same internal structure as projectDirectory.

{agentName}.md.description: Agent instruction file with YAML frontmatter

expansions/{name}.md.description: Simple single-file expansion. Loaded when agent frontmatter declares expansion: {name}

expansions/{name}/{name}.md.description: Complex folder expansion. Main file may reference additional files in the same folder.

logs.note: All log endpoints support optional query params: limit (integer), and log-type-specific filters.

websocket.description: WebSocket connection for real-time updates. All messages are JSON with { type, data, timestamp }.
websocket.note: Subscribe by connecting. No explicit subscription message needed. Events are broadcast to all connected clients.

agent:heartbeat.note: pid may be 0 when broadcast from the /heartbeat endpoint (no spawned process)

task:completed.note: Emitted on unlock and task completion. Event name is semantic — does not imply task status is 'done'.

lockMechanism.description: How task locking works in TaskMaster v3
flow: 1. Agent calls PATCH /tasks/:taskId/lock with { agent, reclaim_after_minutes }
2. Server checks: task status must not be done/failed/blocked
3. Server checks: all depends_on task IDs must have status 'done'
4. Server checks: requires_human must not be true
5. Server sets: locked_by, locked_at, reclaim_after, status=in_progress, started (if not set)
6. Server writes lock file to projects/{projectId}/locks/{taskId}.lock
7. Agent sends PATCH /heartbeat every heartbeat_interval seconds to extend reclaim_after by 15 min
8. On completion: PATCH /tasks/:taskId with status=done clears all lock fields automatically
9. On failure: PATCH /tasks/:taskId with status=failed clears all lock fields automatically
10. On force-unlock: POST /tasks/:taskId/unlock resets to pending and removes lock file
lockMechanism.reclaimConditions: If reclaim_after has passed and no heartbeat received, the lock is considered stale. AGENT_TASKMASTER may reclaim by calling /lock again.

advancement: All tasks in tier N must have status 'done'
If approvedTier is set in tasks.json, that tier must be <= the completed tier before advancing
AGENT_TASKMASTER checks at the end of each task completion whether the tier is complete
On tier complete: broadcast tier:complete WebSocket event
tierWorkflow.gates: Gate tasks (gate field set) serve as approval checkpoints. AGENT_TASKMASTER enforces gate clearance before advancing.
tierWorkflow.pausing: Set paused: true in tasks.json to pause the workflow. Server broadcasts workflow:paused event.
